ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the right side of the image is a production flow chart of a coastal steel base; the top is the port, and raw materials coke and iron ore enter the steel production link; during the production process, “three wastes” are marked, and arrows point to related links such as the building materials plant and treatment plant. Then reason: the building materials plant is near the steel base, so it can nearby absorb and utilize some of the waste generated by steel production as building materials raw materials, reducing the direct discharge of waste into the environment. Therefore, its impact on environmental pollution is to reduce environmental pollution.
